feed.title: ‘They’re Absolute Hogwash’: Ramsey Blacklists AmEx, a Stock Up 470% in 10 Years
feed.summary: Dave Ramsey has blacklisted American Express, Truist Financial (formerly SunTrust), and Fifth Third Bank, attributing his strong aversion to a personal bankruptcy 40 years ago. While these companies have shown significant stock growth, Ramsey argues that rewards cards are "hogwash" for those who carry a balance, as the high interest rates far outweigh any cashback benefits. He emphasizes that rewards only benefit consumers who pay off their balance in full each month, otherwise, they are funding bank profits.

feed.title: Tyson Foods, MGP Ingredients, Conagra, Flowers Foods, and General Mills Shares Are Falling, What You Need To Know
